  • The company’s ability to raise prices without significant customer pushback highlights how crucial its high-capacity drives are to cloud providers. Profitability is tied less to unit volumes and more to disciplined pricing and industry supply control.

Any break in pricing restraint or a pause in cloud buildouts due to power and permitting limits could pressure utilisation and margins. The latest margin print helps the story, but it does not erase these risks.
